notes: Two «ح» branches each end at their own names; the names written once after the last «ح» (الأعمش, أبي، صالح, أبي هريرة) are the shared tail for both branches.
«بمثل حديث سهيل عن أبيه» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route.
«أبي، صالح» and «أبي، شيبة» keep their commas as the text writes them; «أبي» (the relation) is occurrence 2.
